name: wire-wrapper-root-smokes-into-validate
title: Aggregate standalone smoke tests into the lattice validate battery
description: Root package.json defines test as npm run test:e2e (only cli-e2e.js), and lattice validate's fallback runs npm test. So a family of real, passing smoke tests is invisible to validate, creating regression-blindness: test:storydir-inside-gitroot-smoke and test:storydir-inside-gitroot-suite (B-198c), test:gitroot-cwd-routing (B-2856), test:bare-gate-gitroot-cwd (B-3990), plus test:evidence-state-gate-smoke and test:authority-gate-* . This was surfaced as finding B-3990:F-001 (medium) and dismissed there as an out-of-scope systemic gap that needs its own story. Fix: add a single aggregator that the validate run executes (e.g. a test:smokes script chained into test, or a validate.command in lattice.config), so a future refactor of verifier.ts, the gitRoot resolvers, or the authority/evidence gates cannot silently break these fixes. Scope: wiring + the aggregator; do not change the smokes' assertions.
